decisions.reason: A two-component glass flake spraying system builds directly on the firm's core spraying and pump know-how, so it can read early market feedback and refine the product, even though it is only mentioned on the website.

The low-pressure injection pump sits squarely within the firm's existing pump engineering knowledge, and its dedicated page signals commitment and good capacity to assimilate and apply learning from early results.
The low-pressure material transfer pump is a close extension of established pump technology, so the firm can improve it with its own R&D despite its modest web presence.

Fire protection flow monitoring is further from the core spraying and pump knowledge and involves sensing and regulatory demands, but its dedicated page and related fluid-handling expertise justify keeping it while the firm builds knowledge.
